data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at the start of 2018 were GBP 772.3m. During 2018 the syndicate reports an overall improvement in prior-year claims reserves of GBP 11.3m (a release), attributed primarily to favourable claims development. The improvement follows remedial underwriting actions and market rate responses after the events of 2017; however, 2018 was impacted by several catastrophe events (Florence, Michael and California wildfires). Movement by individual lines shows both releases and strengthenings across classes, with large releases in property-related classes offset by increases in certain energy and reinsurance acceptance exposures.
raw_causal_phrases: In 2018, there has been an overall improvement of GBP 11.3m (2017: deterioration of GBP 53.7m).

The syndicate has also further strengthened reserves on business written prior to 2018 in short tail lines particularly North American property and Marine lines of business that had seen the most rate pressure in previous years.
These lines were also affected by the increased transfer of open market business into facilities. This lengthens the tail of each class and reduces underwriting control.
The lack of market response following the events of 2017 reinforced the necessity of the underwriting actions we began to take in 2017 on underperforming lines of business.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary opening reserve taken from Statement of Financial Position (gross claims outstanding 2017 comparative). Prior-year development amount derived from narrative statement 'overall improvement of GBP 11.3m' (document does not present a clear labelled 'movement in prior year's provision' gross figure in an easily extractable labeled line). A gross claims development triangle is present in the notes but OCR/formatting ambiguity prevented reliable automated extraction of the full diagonal movements; therefore the prior-year movement uses the narrative figure with moderate confidence. Lob movements are computed from the 'concentration of outstanding claim liabilities by class' table (gross liabilities 2018 vs 2017).
